plan.title: 2x2 genotype x drug interaction DE + pathway analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the drug act differently in KO than in WT — is a genotype x treatment interaction question on a 2x2 factorial design (WT/KO x vehicle/drug, n=4/cell, 16 samples, 12000 genes, raw salmon counts, human brain). The correct test is not four pairwise comparisons but a single DESeq2 model with design ~genotype+treatment+genotype:treatment. The interaction coefficient IS the answer to 'does the drug act differently by genotype' — it is a difference-of-differences (drug effect in KO minus drug effect in WT). We also report the two simple effects (drug vs vehicle within WT; drug vs vehicle within KO) alongside the interaction so a reader can see whether the drug affects either genotype at all before interpreting the interaction. With 4 replicates/cell the interaction test has intentionally limited power (rule R-0013) and this is stated explicitly rather than glossed over. Steps: (1) sample-structure QC to confirm the 4 groups separate and no sample is a genotype/treatment outlier before any test is trusted; (2) a single DESeq2 fit with minimal pre-filtering and median-of-ratios normalization internal to the model, from which the interaction Wald test and the two simple-effect contrasts are all extracted (avoids re-fitting three separate models); (3) ashr shrinkage of all three contrasts (interaction and simple effects are not single model coefficients so apeglm is not used); (4) BH-FDR per contrast with independent filtering; (5) a fgsea preranked enrichment on the Wald statistic, once per contrast (interaction, WT simple effect, KO simple effect), against MSigDB Hallmark first then Reactome and WikiPathways as follow-up collections, all present in the reference store for human; (6) a consolidated report presenting the three contrasts side by side with fit diagnostics, leading-edge genes, and the full reproducibility record. The knowledge-service check flagged that fgsea/GSEA is not the permitted enrichment method under a bare 'differential_expression' framing but IS permitted once the situation is declared as an enrichment step on a ranked list (confirmed via a second, scoped check) — the full_plan and enrichment-scoped checks both passed clean, so the plan below uses that grounded combination.
